Results.ReviewText:
Fantastic grill that my wife bought me for my birthday. It's been a while since I cooked on gas, and I was pleasantly surprised at the thoughtful and user-friendly advancements to these units. For example, the spring-loaded gas gauge is such a simple yet useful addition. Also, aftermarket support and customization for this model is really, really good. I look forward to using a griddle grate and rotisserie when we purchase those.

For a small family grill, this Spirit II really punches above its weight!
Results.Title: Spirit II punches way above its weight

Results.ReviewText:
Beautiful grill just the right size for a small family. Easy to move, clean, and maintain with fingertip control of flame levels. LOVE the super easy grease catching pans and how affordable replacements are. I previously owned a big four-burner with an extra side burner but since we don't throw parties for thirty folks and are now empty nesters, it was too much hassle to deal with, especially cleaning. This grill is perfect for everyday use.
Caveat: My son bought this as a gift so it arrived fully assembled (except they put the lighting battery in backwards, easy fix) but looking at the instruction booklet, I don't think I would have much difficulty with assembly.
Results.Title: Perfect for a small family and small gatherings.

Results.ReviewText: Overall, I am very satisfied with this grill. This replaces the same model I purchased 20 years ago.  As most things today it is more cheaply made with flimsier parts, but they have made significant engineering changes that have improved the product. Important parts are now stainless steel and the heat distribution is much improved. A warning to the less mechanically inclined, the grill comes disassembled in about a hundred parts.  The instructions are excellent and the parts well labeled, but it took my wife and I 2 hours to put it together.
Results.Title: A solid purchase for mid level grill

Results.ReviewText: The two grids and burners are perfectly sized for whole birds and full sized pizzas as well as burgers and brats for our family. I love that the parts which get dirty with use can be essily lifted off and washed in our normal-sized utility sink. Best of all, I’m happy to be using propane for its quick starts and economical cooking times and no more particulate matter from charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: We replaced our old Weber Q grill we'd used for over a decade (still working, too). The Spirit II is also small, but just that bit bigger to make grilling a pleasure. I even have a 12" pizza stone that does a wonderful job. I worried that without a 3rd burner I'd have trouble controlling indirect heat, but so far, so good. The only "issue" I have is in moving it. Because there are no wheels on the left hand side, you need to tilt that end up to move it easily across deck boards; however, the table-tray on that same side is removable and tends to come off if you lift from that side ... so, a bit tricky. Other than that, it's been the perfect small grill for our family of 2 with occasional guest couples.
Results.Title: Just the right size

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
